title: fix(console): Studio's home currency amount editor holds a partial pick instead of autosaving it

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 字段编辑器里「本位币金额」的三个选择(本位币金额字段、单据日期、汇率字段)在只选了一两个时先留在编辑器里、不写进草稿,下方一行提示还缺哪几个;三个选齐或全部清空时才一次性写入。汇率字段的候选按屏幕上(尚未保存的)单据日期判定。
- 为什么改:spec 要求三个指针要么全有要么全无,原来每选一个就提交一次,自动保存把半成品发给服务端,连续两次 422「Changes not saved」后第三次才成功;清空时也一样。
- 风险与回滚:只动 app-shell 的这一个编辑器和两条 i18n 文案,spec 与服务端零改动;编辑一个已完整的本位币金额到另一个完整值时照旧立即保存。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`CurrencyConfigField.tsx` 的 `pickHomePointer`(何时提交、何时留住)与 `ObjectCurrencyConfigField`(按字段 `key` 与 `homeCandidatesFor`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx`,预期 19 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/CurrencyConfigField.tsx`:

- **The hold.** `CurrencyConfigField` keeps a partial `homeAmount` (one or two of `field`, `rateDate`, `rateField` set) in its own state, `heldHome`, and does not call `onCommit` for it. `pickHomePointer` applies the pick with the existing `setHomeAmountPointer` to what is on screen, then commits only when the result has all three pointers or none. The three pickers show the held picks. The hold is stamped with the committed `homeAmount` it was picked against, so a change to that from elsewhere (a reload, an undo) ends it instead of being overridden by it. A commit from elsewhere in the section (the currency field, the mode) carries the committed `homeAmount`, never the held one.
- **The hint.** While a pick is held, one line under the pickers (`data-testid="currency-config-home-amount-held"`, `role="status"`) says the change is not saved yet and names the pointers still to pick, by their picker labels. It is not the red refusal banner, and it stays until the pick is completed or cleared: nothing auto-reverts. New key `designer.field.currency.homeAmountHeld` in the studio namespace, `en` and `zh` (the only two packs that namespace has).
- **Candidates judged against the held pick.** `homeAmountCandidates` offers a rate field shared with another amount only when that amount uses the same code field and document date, judged from the object's committed definition. With the document date now held, `ObjectCurrencyConfigField` passes a new optional `homeCandidatesFor(home)` that judges the candidates against the object with the held `homeAmount` in place; the existing pin "picking the three pointers writes homeAmount, and the object parses" (pick `shared_rate` after the date) caught this.
- **One field's hold stays on that field.** `ObjectCurrencyConfigField` renders the editor with `key={self}`, so a held pick on one amount never shows on the next field the inspector opens. Selecting another field drops the held pick, which the hint said was not saved.

Not changed: `packages/spec` (`CurrencyConfigSchema.homeAmount` still takes all three or none), the server, `setHomeAmountPointer`, `homeAmountCandidates`, and every host of the editor. No client-side fallback value is written.

## Why

- **Measured on `origin/main` `f068cde8`** (a throwaway test, not committed, rendering `ObjectFieldInspector` on a record-mode `amount` with a live draft, recording each `onPatch` and parsing the object with `ObjectSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the judge behind the server's `422 INVALID_METADATA`). The pick is committed by the `onCommit` of each `homeAmount` picker, which called `setHomeAmountPointer` and committed the result. Readings:
  - pick Home amount field: 1 commit, `homeAmount={"field":"amount_home"}`, refused at `fields.amount.currencyConfig.homeAmount.rateDate` and `...homeAmount.rateField` ("`homeAmount` needs `rateDate`", "needs `rateField`");
  - pick Document date: 1 commit, refused at `...homeAmount.rateField`;
  - pick Rate field: 1 commit, parses.
  - Clearing a complete one: 1 commit refused at `...homeAmount.field`, 1 commit refused at `...homeAmount.field` and `...homeAmount.rateDate`, then 1 commit with no `homeAmount`, parses.
- **The precedent.** The hooks panel holds a CEL error back from its autosave: the inspector reports a blocking count and `useDraftAutoSave` is blocked while it stands. The order's ruling keeps the partial state local and uncommitted instead, so no draft carries a half-built `homeAmount`, nothing else in the draft is held back with it, and the page shows no save-blocked line; the hold is the editor's own, as the CEL editor's verdict is.

## Tests

`CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` "Studio homeAmount editor holds a partial pick back from the draft" (the file is this editor's shared harness; it drives the rendered `ObjectFieldInspector` through its real Radix selects and spies on `onPatch`, the commit the autosave sends):

- the first pick commits nothing, keeps the pick on screen, and names the two pointers still to pick;
- the second pick commits nothing; the third commits once, with all three, and the object parses;
- clearing a complete `homeAmount` holds until the last pointer is cleared, then commits once with none;
- a commit from elsewhere in the section keeps the held picks and the hint, and sends no partial `homeAmount`;
- CONTROL: a complete `homeAmount` edited to another complete one commits once (green on base too);
- the fixture parses bare and with a complete `homeAmount`.

<details><summary>Red on base, green on the fix, ablation red</summary>

- Base `f068cde8` (pins only): `Tests 4 failed | 15 passed (19)`, the four hold pins red, CONTROL and fixture green.
- Fix: `CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx` + `CurrencyConfigField.parentPath-31912.test.tsx`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)`.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `setHeldHome({ against: committedHome, home: next.homeAmount! });` replaced by `onCommit(next);`, anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `63492afeba7e` → `79389c3d2790`; the test imports the editor from `src/`, no dist in the path): `Tests 4 failed | 15 passed (19)`, the first pin among them; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>
